title: Dangerous attachments in practice
intro: Names can lie, check the file type. Decide what you would do in each moment from this module's lessons.

decisions.title: Qerar_2026.pdf.exe
decisions.prompt: Show extensions. What does the end of the name say?
decisions.explain: A real decree is never a program.

decisions.title: Protected View: this file came from the internet
decisions.prompt: The document is blank and wants a click. What do you do?

artifact.title: Protected View: this file came from the internet
body: The document is blank, only a picture shows:
"To see the text, click Enable Editing, then Enable Content."

decisions.explain: A blank page asking for a click is a trap.

decisions.title: Hesabat_sentyabr.iso
decisions.prompt: What do you do with this file?
decisions.explain: Do not open a disk image you did not expect.

decisions.title: Telimat_2026.pdf
decisions.explain: Internal address, expected document, ordinary PDF. Fine to open.

decisions.title: Maas_cedveli.xlsx.lnk
decisions.explain: A shortcut wearing a spreadsheet name. Opening it can run a hidden command.
